Litwick Cave (Japanese: ヒトモシ Cave) is a cave located in the North End disctrict of Ryme City in the game . It is a damp cave with underground water flowing through it , and is one of the city's famous spots, being popular with tourists as well as with couples. Most of Chapter 2 in Detective Pikachu takes place here.
